verdict.rationale: Square documents a dedicated Refunds API supporting both linked and unlinked refunds (full/partial refunds for existing or off-platform payments), which covers the API side, and the dashboard is implied via the broader Square seller product but not explicitly documented for refund issuance in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit dashboard UI documentation/screenshots showing refund issuance from the Seller Dashboard, and confirmation of partial-amount refund support in docs text.
